title: Conditional κ = 0.00315120 (+3.3e-7 over #6372): three shared-carrier input lifts
body:
Stacks on #6372, as #6372 stacked on #6353. The diff against #6372's head is
`research/p104-shared-carrier-lifts/` only.

## Change

Six public helpers of the #6372 word (520, 655, 544, 671, 472, 624) are
prepared at the zero frame and leave it for a first-destination frame. Here each
starts at a smaller entrance frame inside that destination (frame 106 or 105).
The preparation response of each helper is delivered by ordinary ADDs: to rows of
its first-destination group right after they arrive, and to one carrier row per
pair (171, 208, 130), which makes a single `Z -> F -> old destination` detour
shared by both helpers of the pair. Each lifted helper is restored at the final
frame by ordinary ADDs. The word has 17,768 events, 770 public inputs, 29 owned
fields, 43 owned lifetimes (unchanged) and peak owned storage 13.

| carrier (group dim) | entrance F | lifted helpers (first-destination dim) |
|---|---|---|
| 171 (2) | span{30}, frame 106 | 520 (3); 655 (5) |
| 208 (2) | span{51}, frame 105 | 544 (3); 671 (5) |
| 130 (2) | span{51}, frame 105 | 472 (3); 624 (5) |

## Result

| | #6372 | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| conditional kappa | 0.00315087 | **0.00315120** (+3.3e-7, +0.0105 percent) |
| rational crossing | (0.00315087900390, 0.00315087900391) | (0.00315120852329, 0.0031512085233) |
| paid jobs (19 copies) | 70,656 | 70,713 |
| productive fields / surplus | 14,214 / 808 | 14,214 / 808 |
| local paid ranks per copy | | +6 at 1, -3 at 3, +3 at 4, -3 at 5 |
| local productive ranks per copy | | +6 at 8, -6 at 9 |

Conditional kappa = 0.00315120 (+3.3e-7 over #6372). It inherits the same five
framework assumptions as #6349, #6353 and #6372: `native_all_columns`,
`owned_erasure`, `compiler`, `precision_tape`, `analytic_recovery`.

## Tariff scope

The gain is exactly zero at linear cost: paid and productive rank mass both fall
by six per copy. With `H_r = r^s` it is positive only for `s` of about 0.873 to 1
(+0.0839 over the 19 copies at the claimed exponent) and negative for smaller `s`
and for the square root. The claim holds at the stated exponent only, the same
basis as #6349's exact power-moment check. It is not a result for every concave
tariff.

## Evidence

- The package verifier rebuilds the word from #6372's word (retained in
  `inputs/` with exact Git and SHA256 pins) using `construct.py` and `LIFTS.json`,
  and compares every field.
- Full checker stack on the rebuilt word: replay, separate dense reverse columns
  (799 columns, 638,401 coefficients), native absolute phases, all caller
  contacts of the fixed #6348 caller (the caller payload is compared to
  `CONTROLLER.json`), complete tree invoice, both interval engines, compiler and
  all 54 strict plus four functional outer predicates.
- Rejection controls: the inherited caller, price and damaged-input controls
  plus lift-specific ones (response doubled, response sign flipped, restore
  dropped, first delivery dropped, anchor MOVE dropped, MOVE destination
  shifted, entrance reverted). All reject.
- An independent read-only audit with separately written exact row and ownership
  code reproduced the census, the local deltas and the crossing (60-digit
  bisection), and measured the tariff sensitivity above.
- No owned field or lifetime is added; the lifts add 40 MOVE and ADD events.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-shared-carrier-lifts --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-shared-carrier-lifts
```

Both pass locally, as does `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'`
(711 tests).

## Scope and assumptions

Source-bound conditional improvement under the five inherited assumptions. No
global optimum, selected-frontier change, materialized rounded multiplier,
practical speedup, independent scientific acceptance or formal-kernel acceptance
is claimed. The gain is small.

## Provenance and credit

The source word, joint basis method, native transpose, native input-lift move
class, fixed binary-tree caller and price engine are Ali Romman's #6372, #6353,
#6349 and #6348 line; #6349 builds on DreamingOfClouds #6314. NOTICE preserves
the predecessor notices. Apache-2.0, as #6372.
